text: Sparse migration complete. SparseNeuroVec owns exactly one rank-2 Ravel payload with logical shape (time, support-position) plus one ordered typed SparseSupport. Fixed subVector support-order corruption caused by lookup re-sorting; ordered [2,0] support now survives slicing and dense roundtrip. Duplicate support is rejected, missing selection policies are typed, zero-fill/densification laws pass, and compact storage size is asserted below dense size. Dense gather, dense scatter, concat, and sparse arithmetic no longer allocate full legacy staging buffers. Serialization contract records geometry, time extent, ordered support, and logical values, never raw offsets. Gates: image JVM and JS suites pass (including new order law); fitJVM/test 154/154; fitJS/test 146/146; all image/fit JVM and JS Test/compile gates pass; static raw buffer access remains 0.
